title:	admin: an action that renders a confirmation page logs "Executed action" before anything ran
state:	OPEN
number:	19460
--
`HoopitAdmin.response_action` (`club_united_api/django/admin.py:712`) writes one `Executed action on N objects: <action>` LogEntry per selected row whenever the action returns, including an action that only renders a confirmation or form page first. `merge_users` (`users/admin/user_admin.py`) renders its `MergeUserForm` before merging, so every time an admin opens the merge form, cancels it, or submits an invalid form, `django_admin_log` records an executed merge, and a confirmed merge is logged twice.

## Why it matters

`django_admin_log` is what we read to count how often staff do something (merges, exports, force logouts). Every count of an action with an intermediate page overstates it: for `merge_users` the log rows are an upper bound, not a count.

## Acceptance

An action that renders an intermediate page writes no `Executed action` entry for that render; a confirmed run writes exactly one per row it changed. A test in `club_united_api/test/test_admin.py` opens the merge form, cancels, and asserts no entry.
